title: Knowledge state counts a conflict entry closed as not a source disagreement as open
goal: KnowledgeState.open_conflicts treats a _conflicts.md entry with a '- Reviewed <date>, not a source disagreement' note as closed, as it does '- Resolved <date>' and '- Superseded <date>', while a '- Reviewed <date>, still open' note leaves the entry open; a test plants each note, and kb/_self/backlog.md and tools.md name the closing notes

run: import sys,types;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import backlog;o=backlog.KnowledgeState(types.SimpleNamespace(kb=None)).open_conflicts();b=[e['file']+':'+str(e['line']) for e in o if 'not a source disagreement' in e['text']];print(len(b),b[:3]);sys.exit(1 if b else 0)
